Q-1.note: The app uses the Design copy: the bottom bar reads 「Select 1 to 20 photos to continue.」 「(0/20)」 with 「Next」 (not the PM 「Done」), 「Next」 disabled at 0 and enabled once a photo is selected (TC-005, TC-007, TC-010 Pass). The rows already expect this.

Q-3.note: The Setting button opens the app's 「Settings」 page (General Settings, Image Quality Settings, Camera Settings …); system Back returns to Batch Edit Room with the batch unchanged (TC-025 Pass).

Q-4.note: Same as Edit Room: holding the compare button shows the original photo and releasing it brings the edit back (TC-026 Pass, photo 1 cropped Square).

Q-5.note: The app does both, each in its own case: a ratio chosen without 「All」 gives a box centred on that photo (TC-049: position holds, the row fails only on pixel sizes), and 「All」 places the other photos' boxes at the source's relative position as Section 3 concludes (TC-051, TC-052, TC-053, TC-055 Pass). The rows already follow Section 3.

Q-6.note: Already with PM on the open Android tickets PHA262026P0122 (237 x 237 accepted, below Section 3's 238 px minimum) and PHA262026P0123 (the out-of-range toast names only the width). Matched by title: whether they also raise the 2560 px maximum against Section 3's 2730 is to be checked on the tickets.
